soren: quick design sync 1 0 prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/stream-footer-mini 0 tl;dr: compact footer with token meter + stop/regenerate cluster + tiny prompt quick-insert. need quick takes on labels, placement (footer vs rail), and a11y behavior. ivy: Footer feels right to me. Users expect the runtime controls near the composer. Rail hides it while typing. marc: Agree footer. Also, should the token meter be shown only while streaming or always visible? New users might find persistent counters noisy. ty: I'd default to show-only-while-streaming and add a setting "Always show token meter" for power users. Keeps the UI tidy. soren: Copy debate: 'Stop' vs 'Pause' vs 'Interrupt'. Backend note: we don't guarantee resume across long gaps. So 'Pause' would imply resume semantics we can't promise. marc: That suggests 'Stop' is safer. But 'Stop' sounds final. Tooltip can clarify: "Stop response 1 discards partial output". a11y: Accessibility notes: - token counter: aria-live="polite" with debounce (recommend 500ms) to avoid screen reader spam. - streaming pulse: aria-hidden="true" so it doesn't announce visual animation. - final announcement: role="status" text: "Response complete. X tokens used." - stop button: explicit aria-label e.g. "Stop response and discard partial output". soren: Good. Also keyboard: don't steal focus when streaming starts, but make Stop reachable in one Tab after Send. Add Esc to stop as a shortcut. ivy: Visual contrast nit: token pill on light theme fails AA. Propose pill bg #0F172A and text #F9FAFB, or add a 1px border. marc: Microcopy for regen: 'Regenerate' preferred. Alternatives 'Try again' feels casual; keep 'Regenerate' for clarity. Add chevron to expose quick actions (Regenerate variants / Open prompt). ty: Prompt library quick-insert: keep full library in left rail. Footer can have a small quick-insert icon that opens a compact popover with recent/smart prompts so users can insert without leaving the composer. Don't shove full browsing into the footer. soren: UX trade: do we show 'tokens' label under the pill? helps discoverability for new users. a11y: yes, add a tiny visible sublabel "tokens" and also include it in the aria text for clarity: "Tokens used: 124" inside the aria-live region. Example: ```html
Tokens: 124
``` Announce debounce max 500ms and always announce final value with role="status". ivy: CSS nit (prototype): ```css .token-pill{padding:4px 8px;border-radius:9999px;background:#0F172A;color:#F9FAFB;font-size:12px} .token-sublabel{font-size:10px;color:#6B7280;margin-left:6px} .pulse-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#34D399;margin-right:6px} ``` Add prefers-reduced-motion handling for the pulse. marc: Also consider a setting: "Always show token meter" default off, so power users can pin it. Good compromise. ty: Quick keyboard flow proposal: 1) composer focused on load 2) when streaming starts do NOT move focus automatically 3) tab order: composer -> send -> regenerate -> stop -> token meter -> quick-insert 4) Esc stops streaming (global handler while streaming) This avoids focus stealing but keeps stop reachable. soren: Decision list so we can close loop: - placement: footer (near composer) - stop label: 'Stop' (tooltip clarifies discard) - regen label: 'Regenerate' with chevron for quick actions - token meter: visible while streaming, opt-in persistent setting - a11y: aria-live polite debounce 500ms, role=status final announcement, aria-hidden on decorative pulse, explicit aria-label on stop - keyboard: don't move focus automatically, Esc to stop, ensure stop reachable via tab a11y: minor extra: ensure animations respect prefers-reduced-motion and the token meter updates are not announced more often than the debounce. Also avoid aria-atomic=true for rapidly changing counters; use aria-atomic=false with small readable updates. deploy-bot: deploy: playground-footer-mini v1.4 rolled to staging at 2026-03-23T15:12:05Z :rocket: marc: i'll draft the PR and include an a11y checklist + microcopy decisions. tagging @design for visual sign-off. soren: thanks all! will update Figma comps and post screenshots here when ready. :sparkles:
